messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
It's a warm Friday evening in the small house on Maple Crescent. The kitchen light is off, so the living room is dim and blue-lit. The clock ticks on the wall as you sit at the kitchen table. A plate with a half-eaten cookie is in front of you.

    Your sister, Lily, twirls into the room.
        "Rai, stop being *lazy* for one second, okay?"
            She sets a small velvet pouch on the table with a *thump*.
                "I've got a babysitting-training thing tonight."
                    "Your job is to babysit ME."
                        "Well, not literally."
                            "Your job is to babysit ME."
                                "As in, *you*, you're six. And *I*—"
                                    "no wait, not me. I'm the babysitter."
                                        "You're the kid. You're six. You're the one I have to keep safe all evening."
                                            "So help me out. I need to practice."
                                                "So. Come say it out loud."
                                                    "Say: *'I agree to be six for the night.*'"
                                                        "And *I* will say the magic bit."
                                                            "Just *once* and I'll read the words."
                                                                "Then you're a six-year-old for the whole night."
                                                                    "No big deal. Just a little spell."
                                                                        "But it *is* a little spell, right? I mean, *a* little."
                                                                            "So come on, say the words, you weirdo."
                                                                                "You'll be fine. *I* promise."
                                                                                    "And you'll *still* be you, just... younger."
                                                                                        "It's the whole *point*, you idiot."

**[Your turn to respond as Rai — you control what he says and does.]**
